messages:
chris: Heads up — NimbusBank returned our bespoke security questionnaire and flagged two blocking items: (1) audit log export returning 401 intermittently, (2) they need HSM attestation + KMS rotation timeline. Due Fri 2026-03-26. Can we triage? cc @tom-cs

maya: thanks — can you paste the exact error sample + request_id + times? also which export pathway (console vs API)?

chris: customer says they used Console > Settings > Export, saw UI error and got an email 'export failed: unauthorized'. They asked to avoid PII in channel. Sample from the email: 'Export failed for export-id ex_9f1... code 401. Contact support.'

ashwin: @maya please escalate to eng-security? I'll start on repro. quick ask: can we get the customer's request_id (if in the email) and a timestamp window?

maya: asked customer for: 1) request_id in the email 2) approximate timestamp (UTC) 3) org id 4) whether they tried API curl. Sent at 09:12 PT.

nimbus-cust: provided request_id req_NM12345, org nimbus-123, UTC window 2026-03-02T11:30:00Z - 2026-03-02T12:15:00Z. They also had a scheduled KMS key rotation at 11:46Z and saw retries/billing spikes.

ashwin: reproducer plan: 1) attempt export via API with an access token that predates rotation; 2) check keystore/key version mismatch returning 401. Example run:

curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' 'https://api.redwood.ai/v1/audit/export?org=nimbus-123&start=2026-03-02T11:20Z&end=2026-03-02T12:10Z' -v

ashwin: sample server log from local repro:

{"ts":"2026-03-02T11:46:05Z","level":"error","msg":"audit export auth failed","code":401,"request_id":"req_NM12345","user":"nimbus-123","err":"token key not found"}

This matches a short window during key rotation where tokens bound to the old key are rejected.

lisa-prod: Eng-Security confirmation — tokens issued against the previous key can fail until clients refresh. For Console exports we should have a fallback path; investigate why that didn't kick in. @ashwin can you check token refresh cache TTL and fallback controller?

ashwin: noted. quick check: staging showed cache TTL=120s, but prod may have held a stale value after a deploy. I'll query telemetry and add a temporary metric to surface it.

maya: customer also flagged a billing spike due to repeated export retries. Asked finance to waive incremental export charges if we confirm rotation caused the failures. @bryce-fin pls advise.

bryce-fin: happy to review a waiver. Need support ticket id + eng confirmation that exports failed due to rotation. Hold until we have the sanitized evidence.

tom-cs: customer deadline is Fri 2026-03-26 for CAIQ. If we can provide a PKCS#7-signed HSM attestation + rotation timeline and a sanitized export log sample (no PII) by Wed we can meet it. Can security/legal produce this package?

security-bot: automated note — HSM attestation request created SEC-7891; est turnaround 3 business days once legal signs off.

legal-ops: pinged for POA and redaction scope. Need to confirm what fields the customer expects removed.

ashwin: next steps — (A) ask customer to re-run export via API with a fresh token (curl snippet above) and send any new request IDs if still failing; (B) we will produce a sanitized log sample for CAIQ with header-only entries (fields: ts, request_id, action, result_code) and include rotation timeline: key rotate start 2026-03-02T11:45Z, completed 2026-03-02T11:47Z; tokens issued before 11:47Z may fail until refresh. (C) eng will add temporary alert: >0.5% export 401 rate over 15m. If triggered we will investigate immediate fallback rollback.

chris: relaying plan to customer and updating ticket. attaching SEC-7891 in ticket for traceability.

nimbus-cust: thanks — one question: is PKCS#7-signed PDF an acceptable attestation format? That's what our compliance team requested.

lisa-prod: format OK. Security will provide PKCS#7-signed PDF attestation plus a signed CSV rotation timeline. We'll send pre-redacted samples to the ticket.

maya: marking this high priority and will update the ticket with the sanitized export once ready. :thumbsup:
